headline: Best Planting Pal in Palworld
title: Best Planting Pal in Palworld | Dandilord | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Planting Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Dandilord, with level eight Planting, plus Handiwork and Medicine. Dandilord is the World Tree farmer, and Lyleen is a strong choice before the endgame. The best alternative is Lyleen, with level seven Planting and great Gathering. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Planting at your base? Comment below!
